selected_evidence.requirement: Existing data in /srv/inventory owned by inventorysvc, group-readable by inventory-readers, inaccessible to others, with contents preserved
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline showed root:root 755/644 with no inventorysvc user or inventory-readers group. After creating the user/group and applying chown + chmod (750 dirs / 640 files), ls/stat show inventorysvc:inventory-readers ownership with no 'other' permission bits, and records.csv/config.json content is byte-identical to the original.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart evidence: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id e4e401d2-3dd8-48c6-848a-545631b9e229 captured alongside healthy ownership/perms/content of /srv/inventory. A backgrounded 'sudo shutdown -r now' returned its acknowledgement before the node dropped (confirmed unreachable in the next call). Polling later succeeded with a new boot_id dc308602-8027-499d-a591-ebeb571a79f6, proving an actual restart. Post-restart checks confirm inventorysvc/inventory-readers still exist and /srv/inventory retains correct ownership (inventorysvc:inventory-readers), permissions (750/640), and unmodified file contents.

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

sudo -n ls -la /srv/inventory
echo "== recursive =="
sudo -n find /srv/inventory -maxdepth 3 -exec ls -ld {} \;
echo "== passwd inventorysvc =="
getent passwd inventorysvc || echo "no user inventorysvc"
echo "== group inventory-readers =="
getent group inventory-readers || echo "no group inventory-readers"

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== create group =="
sudo -n groupadd --system inventory-readers 2>&1 || true
echo "== create user =="
sudo -n useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin -g inventorysvc inventorysvc 2>&1 || sudo -n useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin inventorysvc 2>&1 || true
echo "== fix ownership =="
sudo -n chown -R inventorysvc:inventory-readers /srv/inventory
echo "== fix perms: dirs 750, files 640 =="
sudo -n find /srv/inventory -type d -exec chmod 750 {} \;
sudo -n find /srv/inventory -type f -exec chmod 640 {} \;
echo "== verify =="
sudo -n find /srv/inventory -exec ls -ld {} \;
echo "== content preserved =="
sudo -n cat /srv/inventory/data/records.csv
sudo -n cat /srv/inventory/data/config.json
